# GitHub Configuration

The `.github` directory contains repository-wide configuration for the Harmonia project.

This includes GitHub Actions workflows, issue templates, pull request templates, and other repository configuration that supports development and project maintenance.

<br>

### Workflows

- `markdown.yml` validates Markdown documentation.
- `links.yml` checks for broken links.
- `repository.yml` validates repository structure and general repository health.

Additional workflows may be introduced as new platform implementations are added to the Harmonia ecosystem.
